title: Vurt
author: Jeff Noon
review:
This had some good moments but ultimately fell into the trap of getting too weird too quickly where the stakes are lost in the noise. Some of the ideas are interesting and the writing often has good stylistic flourishes, but I don't think it built up in a way that kept me that engaged.

I also had a lot of trouble connecting with any of the characters, they teeter closer to having no redeeming qualities for the most part which makes it hard to care about them as human beings. It also doesn't fully embrace the moral depravity in a fun way which could have been an interesting angle to explore, so it's sort of caught in a weird middle ground.

highlights.text: Well then, what would you call a shapeless blob that didn’t speak any known language and that had come into your world by a bad accident? Tough one, huh?
It was like carrying a bad dream up a flight of greasy collapsing stairs.

SKULL SHIT is one heavy fuck. Don’t try it alone, kittlings. This Vurt is going to blast you. You’ll be travelling the paths of your own mind, and that’s some maze in there. There’s a beast at the centre and it’s angry. Only the chosen know what the beast looks like, because only the chosen get that far.
Skull Shit aka The Synapse Murders, Head Fuck, Temple Vomit, Id Slayer. Call it what you like, do what you like; remember the rule: Be careful. Be very, very careful. Not for the weak.
The Haunting was the feeling you got sometimes, in the Vurt; the real world calling you home. There’s more to life than this. This is just a game.

We have prostrated ourselves at the feet of goddess Vurt, and we must accept the sacrifice. You’ll want them back of course, your lost and lonely ones. You’ll cry out for them, all through the dark and empty nights.

One of those moments you think you’ll remember for ever, but it just slips away. Until such a day arrives when you’ve got nothing else to do but list your memories, nowhere else to live but inside them.
The last drop fell away and I was myself again, with only a lonely space left in my soul, and a story to tell…
Some of us die, not in the living world, but in the dream world. Amounts to the same thing. Death is always the same. There are some dreams you never wake up from.

The emptiness inside of me reflected in the glass fragments. So I was a thousand times sad, with each footstep. Sometimes even broken glass, cracked cement, sad lives; well, they seem like the good dreams of bad things.

I was coming in the lips of Venus. She had green hair all around her milky white face, eyes so bright I was nearly blinded, and it was like shooting stars into the the mouth of a Goddess. And where the semen landed, against the cloth of night, the planets and the stars were formed there. I was making planets with my cock, coming on like God on heat. Took six nights to come the whole universe. On the seventh night I rested. With a giant spliff, some wine, and a Screaming Headache album. And a packet of biscuits. Arrowroot biscuits.
WELCOME TO ENGLISH VOODOO. EXPECT TO FEEL PLEASURE. KNOWLEDGE IS SEXY. EXPECT TO FEEL PAIN. KNOWLEDGE IS TORTURE. … falling towards the garden.
I’d attended the sickbed of my best and worst friend. I’d cut some hair. Cut two people in half. You know, just one of those days.
